summary: Enhance your skills in public expenditure budgeting and management with our comprehensive course. Learn effective strategies for better financial governance.
lede: Public expenditure management connects budget planning, allocation, execution and review with policy priorities and service results. The course is for budget, treasury and programme finance professionals who need to strengthen expenditure control and reporting. Participants practice medium-term resource prioritization, commitment and cash-flow controls, and budget-to-actual performance reporting using expenditure data and fiscal-risk analysis.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with public budgets, appropriations, expenditure transactions, treasury operations, or programme performance and need stronger analytical and management capability.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of public budgeting, government expenditure processes, or treasury operations is required. You should be comfortable reading budget estimates, expenditure reports, and basic financial tables. No programming is required. Advanced topics such as AI-assisted expenditure analysis, fiscal-risk scenario testing, and digital reporting are taught at an operational application level, not a technical engineering level. Bring a laptop if possible for spreadsheet-based exercises.
